spec.name: Blind1 Chins
spec.description: The blind's Chins pack, from its own battery management system.

queries.query:
// The pack's own switches and alarms, newest reading in the last day. Each
// field is its own latest value; "read" is how long ago the pack last
// answered at all. Protection names each alarm the pack has raised, and
// balancing names each cell it is bleeding.

import "strings"

protection = (v) =>
    strings.trimSuffix(
    v:
        (if v / 1 % 2 == 1 then "cell over volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 2 % 2 == 1 then "cell under volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 4 % 2 == 1 then "pack over volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 8 % 2 == 1 then "pack under volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 16 % 2 == 1 then "charge too hot, " else "") +
        (if v / 32 % 2 == 1 then "charge too cold, " else "") +
        (if v / 64 % 2 == 1 then "discharge too hot, " else "") +
        (if v / 128 % 2 == 1 then "discharge too cold, " else "") +
        (if v / 256 % 2 == 1 then "charge over current, " else "") +
        (if v / 512 % 2 == 1 then "discharge over current, " else "") +
        (if v / 1024 % 2 == 1 then "short circuit, " else "") +
        (if v / 2048 % 2 == 1 then "front end chip error, " else "") +
        (if v / 4096 % 2 == 1 then "switches locked, " else "") +
        (if v >= 8192 then "other bits " + string(v: v - v % 8192) + ", " else ""),
    suffix: ", ",
)

balancing = (v) =>
    strings.trimSuffix(
    v:
        (if v / 1 % 2 == 1 then "1, " else "") +
        (if v / 2 % 2 == 1 then "2, " else "") +
        (if v / 4 % 2 == 1 then "3, " else "") +
        (if v / 8 % 2 == 1 then "4, " else "") +
        (if v / 16 % 2 == 1 then "5, " else "") +
        (if v / 32 % 2 == 1 then "6, " else "") +
        (if v / 64 % 2 == 1 then "7, " else "") +
        (if v / 128 % 2 == 1 then "8, " else "") +
        (if v / 256 % 2 == 1 then "9, " else "") +
        (if v / 512 % 2 == 1 then "10, " else "") +
        (if v / 1024 % 2 == 1 then "11, " else "") +
        (if v / 2048 % 2 == 1 then "12, " else "") +
        (if v / 4096 % 2 == 1 then "13, " else "") +
        (if v / 8192 % 2 == 1 then "14, " else "") +
        (if v / 16384 % 2 == 1 then "15, " else "") +
        (if v / 32768 % 2 == 1 then "16, " else "") +
        (if v / 65536 % 2 == 1 then "17, " else "") +
        (if v / 131072 % 2 == 1 then "18, " else "") +
        (if v / 262144 % 2 == 1 then "19, " else "") +
        (if v / 524288 % 2 == 1 then "20, " else "") +
        (if v / 1048576 % 2 == 1 then "21, " else "") +
        (if v / 2097152 % 2 == 1 then "22, " else "") +
        (if v / 4194304 % 2 == 1 then "23, " else "") +
        (if v / 8388608 % 2 == 1 then "24, " else "") +
        (if v / 16777216 % 2 == 1 then "25, " else "") +
        (if v / 33554432 % 2 == 1 then "26, " else "") +
        (if v / 67108864 % 2 == 1 then "27, " else "") +
        (if v / 134217728 % 2 == 1 then "28, " else "") +
        (if v / 268435456 % 2 == 1 then "29, " else "") +
        (if v / 536870912 % 2 == 1 then "30, " else "") +
        (if v / 1073741824 % 2 == 1 then "31, " else "") +
        (if v / 2147483648 % 2 == 1 then "32, " else "") +
        (if v >= 4294967296 then "other bits " + string(v: v - v % 4294967296) + ", " else ""),
    suffix: ", ",
)

ago = (t) => string(v: duration(v: (int(v: now()) - int(v: t)) / 1000000000 * 1000000000))

latest = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: -1d)
    |> filter(
        fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms"
                and
                r._field =~ /^(charge_mosfet_on|discharge_mosfet_on|protection_flags|balancing_flags|commands_unanswered)$/,
    )
    |> last()

states = latest
    |> map(
        fn: (r) =>
            ({r with
                _value:
                    if r._field =~ /mosfet/ then
                        if r._value > 0.5 then "on" else "OFF"
                    else if r._value == 0.0 and r._field =~ /flags/ then
                        "none"
                    else if r._field == "protection_flags" then
                        protection(v: int(v: r._value))
                    else if r._field == "balancing_flags" then
                        "cells " + balancing(v: int(v: r._value))
                    else
                        string(v: int(v: r._value)),
            }),
    )

read = latest
    |> group()
    |> max(column: "_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "read", _value: ago(t: r._time) + " ago"}))

union(tables: [states |> group(), read])
    |> keep(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "_value"])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^cell_[0-9]+_volts$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^cell_spread_volts$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^pack_amps$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^state_of_charge_pct$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^remaining_capacity_ah$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.node == "downstairs" and r.device == "bms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^temp_[0-9]+$/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
